new_results.statement: For exact rank three with sigma_min(Lambda)>=1, if an original physical row has leverage c>=1/2 and A_ii=0, then p_Q exists and ||p_Q||_(3/2)<=2; more generally ||p_Q||_p^p <= (sqrt(2)/(r sqrt(c)))^(p-1)/(2-p) for 1<p<2.
In the same branch, every interval I of length epsilon<=1/2 obeys P(Q in I)<=2 epsilon(1+log(1/(2epsilon))).

If two physical rows have leverage at least 5/8 and normalized pivots at most 1/16, then |A_ij|>=3/16, sigma_min of their pair >=1/8, and |det pair|>=1/32. Current pair-log support then gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=32sqrt(5).
